headline: Critics praise Grand Theft Auto VI as a masterpiece
summary: Critics have reviewed Grand Theft Auto VI positively, with one outlet calling it a masterpiece and another praising Rockstar's extraordinarily detailed virtual world, as the most anticipated video game of all time.

claims.statement: Critics have reviewed GTA VI very positively, with reviews calling it extraordinary and a masterpiece.

sources.quote: In GTA VI, Rockstar has created the most extraordinarily, indulgently detailed virtual world that we have yet seen.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics

claims.statement: GTA VI is considered the most anticipated video game of all time.

sources.quote: the most anticipated video game of all time
